{{Vanilla|Dimension}}
[[Matcha Flavoured]] keeps the three vanilla '''dimensions''' but overrides the dimension types of the Overworld and [[Hell]] (the Nether).

== Overworld ==
The pack's Overworld dimension type differs from vanilla in these ways:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/dimension_type/overworld.json}}</ref>
{| class="wikitable"
! Property !! Matcha Flavoured !! Vanilla
|-
| Ambient light color || none ("true darkness") || <code>#0a0a0a</code>
|-
| Beds || Can always be slept in || Only when dark
|-
| Respawn anchors || Work || Do not work
|}

=== True darkness ===
Without an ambient light color, unlit areas of the Overworld are completely dark. The pack ships an alternative file, <code>overworld_no_true_darkness.txt</code>, which is identical except that it sets the ambient light color to <code>#212631</code>. To turn true darkness off, a player deletes <code>overworld.json</code> in the datapack's <code>data/minecraft/dimension_type</code> folder, renames the <code>.txt</code> file to <code>overworld.json</code> and restarts the world.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/dimension_type/I_HATE_TRUE_DARKNESS.txt}}</ref> See [[Darkness]].

=== Time ===
The Overworld's day timeline lasts 72,000 ticks (60 minutes) instead of 24,000, and the moon cycle and villager schedule are stretched to match. See [[Day and night]] and [[Moon]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/timeline/day.json}}</ref>

== Hell ==
{{Main|Hell}}
The Nether is called Hell. Its ambient light is raised to 0.3, its fog reaches 300 blocks, and water no longer evaporates, although the pack removes water that a player pours out below the roof.

== The End ==
{{Main|The End}}
The End's dimension type is unchanged.
